entities.name: Qadir
entities.description: The temperamental ruler of the Fallaji Empire near the start of the Brothers' War, whose Suwwardi enslaved Mishra and who was killed by a dragon engine.

entities.name: Qadir, son of the eldest Qadir
entities.description: The son who inherited the title, grew tyrannical and violent under Mishra's influence, unified the Fallaji and was killed by Ashnod at the Fall of Kroog.

entities.name: Fallaji Empire
entities.description: The desert people led by the Qadirs, unified under the Suwwardi tribe.

entities.name: Suwwardi
entities.description: A militant tribe of the Fallaji ruled by the Qadir, which captured Mishra.

entities.name: Thaladin
entities.description: A Fallaji tribe killed by the mak fawa when it attempted an ambush before submitting.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: A man who wandered the desert with the Weakstone, was made rakiq, then controlled a dragon engine and became the Qadir's wizard.

entities.name: Weakstone
entities.description: The half of the stone carried by Mishra, which he used to overload Urza's automaton.

entities.name: Mightstone
entities.description: Urza's half of the stone, stolen by Kayla bin-Kroog for Mishra and reclaimed by Urza.

entities.name: Hajar
entities.description: A young Fallaji who befriended Mishra at Tocasia's camp and convinced the Qadir to appoint him as tutor.

entities.name: Tocasia
entities.description: The leader of a camp where Hajar befriended Mishra.

entities.name: mak fawa
entities.description: A giant mechanical dragon that appeared from beneath the sands and that Mishra learned to control.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: A builder who became Mishra's apprentice, wielded the Staff of Zegon and killed the younger Qadir during the Fall of Kroog.

entities.name: Staff of Zegon
entities.description: A staff built by Ashnod that can weaken constructs and drain life.

entities.name: Zegon
entities.description: A city that Mishra's mak fawa would not approach, which Ashnod represented.

entities.name: Korlinda
entities.description: The site of the Peace Summit at which the Qadir first calls the Fallaji an empire.

entities.name: Yotia
entities.description: The nation, led from Kroog, that drove the Fallaji from the Sword Marches and was later attacked by Mishra.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Mishra's brother, who declares war after reclaiming his Mightstone.

entities.name: Kayla bin-Kroog
entities.description: The queen of Kroog, convinced by Mishra to steal Urza's Mightstone and later pregnant at the Fall of Kroog.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Freed Ashnod during the Fall of Kroog.

entities.name: Kroog
entities.description: The capital of Yotia, attacked by Mishra and the Fallaji.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war between Urza and Mishra, begun when Urza declared war after Mishra's betrayal at the second summit.

entities.name: Fall of Kroog
entities.description: Mishra's all-out attack on Kroog, during which the Qadir was killed by Ashnod.

entities.name: Great Desert
entities.description: The desert where Mishra was captured and where Urza searched for his camp.

entities.name: Koilos
entities.description: The place to which Mishra was lured by the darkness in his dreams.

events.summary: The Suwwardi capture Mishra in the Great Desert, take his Weakstone and make him a rakiq.
events.quote: The Fallaji took his stone and made him a rakiq (slave)

events.summary: Hajar convinces the Qadir to appoint Mishra as tutor to his son, though Mishra stays rakiq.
events.quote: Hajar convinced the Qadir to appoint Mishra as a tutor to his son

events.summary: The Qadir orders Hajar to have Mishra killed after his son's first war campaign.
events.quote: the Qadir ordered Hajar to have Mishra killed after his son's first war campaign

events.summary: A giant mechanical dragon rises from the sands and slays the Qadir and many others; Mishra finds he can control it.
events.quote: Mishra found he could directly control the dragon instead

events.summary: The Qadir's son becomes the new Qadir and appoints Mishra his raki.
participants: Qadir, son of the eldest Qadir

events.summary: The mak fawa kills the Thaladin ambush, after which the tribe submits and the Suwwardi reign over the Fallaji.
participants: Qadir, son of the eldest Qadir
events.quote: the mak fawa killed them all, saving every Suwwardi in the party

events.summary: At Zegon, Mishra meets Ashnod, who shows him the Staff of Zegon, and he takes her as apprentice.
events.quote: enough to take her on as an apprentice

events.summary: At the Peace Summit at Korlinda the Qadir first calls the Fallaji an empire.
participants: Qadir, son of the eldest Qadir
events.quote: the Qadir first calls the Fallaji an "empire"

events.summary: The peace summit collapses; the Qadir stabs the Yotian Warlord, Urza's automaton chokes the Qadir, and Mishra's Weakstone overloads the automaton.
participants: Qadir, son of the eldest Qadir
events.quote: The Qadir drew his saber and stabbed the warlord in the chest, killing him.

events.summary: At a second summit Mishra convinces Kayla to steal Urza's Mightstone; Urza reclaims it and declares war, starting the Brothers' War.
events.quote: This was the start of the Brothers' War.

events.summary: Mishra attacks Kroog, left undefended by Urza's absence.
events.quote: allowing Mishra to launch an all-out attack on its capital

events.summary: During the Fall of Kroog, Tawnos frees Ashnod and returns the Staff of Zegon so she will protect Kayla.
events.quote: Ashnod was let free by Tawnos

events.summary: Ashnod drains the Qadir's life with the Staff of Zegon, killing him, and Mishra becomes the last Qadir.
participants: Qadir, son of the eldest Qadir
events.quote: Mishra himself became the last Qadir.
